request.style: English, Byzantine Orthodox Easter hymn, a joyful male choir over a bright ison drone, solo cantor leading with ornaments, bells ringing in the distance, no other instruments, exultant, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not be afraid, the angel said
You seek Jesus who was crucified
He is not here, for he is risen
Come and see the place where he lay

[Chorus]
Christ is risen from the dead
Trampling down death by death
The firstfruits of those who sleep
Christ is risen, he is risen indeed

[Verse]
Go quickly now and tell his friends
He is risen from the dead
He goes before you into Galilee
There you will see him as he said

[Chorus]
Christ is risen from the dead
Trampling down death by death
The firstfruits of those who sleep
Christ is risen, he is risen indeed
